name: Two columns · Image, text and CTA
description: Two promotions with equally cropped images, optional title bands, text and aligned buttons.

attribute_definitions.name: Accessible section title
attribute_definitions.description: Not displayed visually; helps identify the block for assistive technologies.

attribute_definitions.name: Align buttons
attribute_definitions.description: Keeps both CTAs at the same height when one description is longer.

attribute_definitions.name: Image
attribute_definitions.description: Select the image and set its focal point in the native editor.

attribute_definitions.name: Alternative text
attribute_definitions.description: Describe the image content. Leave it blank only if the image is decorative.

attribute_definitions.name: Decorative image
attribute_definitions.description: Keeps the alt text empty even when a title is provided.

attribute_definitions.name: Title
attribute_definitions.description: If the title band is hidden, the title remains visually hidden for accessibility.

attribute_definitions.name: Show title band
attribute_definitions.description: Turn it off when the title is already part of the image.

attribute_definitions.name: Open link in a new tab
Title band background
attribute_definitions.description: Use a semantic theme color or select custom.

attribute_definitions.name: Custom title band background
attribute_definitions.description: Used only when Title band background is custom. Choose a color visually or enter a CSS color.

attribute_definitions.name: Custom title color
attribute_definitions.description: Used only when Title color is custom. Choose a color visually or enter a CSS color.
